description: This file defines an AdminController class for a Spring MVC web application. It handles HTTP GET requests to display the admin dashboard, setting up model attributes such as active menu items, store details, country information, and current user data.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing admin dashboard requests, injecting services for country and user data, and preparing model attributes for the admin homepage.

methods.name: displayDashboard
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the admin dashboard page, prepares model attributes such as active menus, store info, country data, current user, and recent order criteria.
